audit.summary: An exact additive-head counterexample refutes the inference from delayed influential-order switching to computational interactions, affecting the central pathway contribution. Published translation example scores corroborate an undisclosed character/space BLEU convention; one illustrated ranking reverses under word tokenization. Those scoring-evidence consequences are Major; corrected aggregate Table8 results remain unknown. PPL labeling, random-Jaccard expectation and duplicated transfer table are Minor.

P1 — Rank-order switching does not identify head interactions — Counterevidence: Actual LLM interactions and task elicitation not disproved. Group ablations/representation similarity establish importance/resemblance but do not exclude this null. Defining independence as rank-increment invariance would be a stronger unprovided assumption, not neural independence.

P2 — Undisclosed character-and-space BLEU materially changes published translation evidence — Counterevidence: Paper says BLEU not expressly wordBLEU; characterBLEU is a defined metric and wordBLEU not semantic truth. Bothbranches use same evaluator. XNLI alpha selection/IWSLT additional dataset and acknowledged style cleanup are positive controls. No corrected aggregate Table8ranking or semantic decline established.
